note: The one configured KEV source: the official cisagov/kev-data mirror resolved through the GitHub API at refresh time (default branch HEAD), then downloaded at that commit and validated (shape, size/count bounds, catalogVersion monotonic vs the newest stored snapshot). KEV changes several times a week, so a pinned commit would silently freeze production intel; the resolved commit is recorded in intel_snapshot.source_uri. www.cisa.gov answers HTTP 403 to this deployment's egress for every path (Akamai IP denial, measured 2026-11-27), so it is not a configured source and nothing falls back to it. Tests, CI and the offline harness use a committed fixture (--fixture / tests/fixtures/intel).
